TOOL_ACT2_SCENE02_MOSCOW.instructions: Drag each requirement into Must, Should, Could, or Won't. Unlike PESTLE/SWOT, there is no single correct answer here — every placement is a real trade-off against budget.

cards.engineNote: Only positive flags are ever set here. filling_line_committed_act2 and automation_marked_must default to false/absent in game_state.json until explicitly set true by a Must/Should placement. Dialogue conditions named 'automation_not_marked_must' and 'filling_line_not_committed_act2' are NOT separately-stored flags — they mean 'the positive flag is false or absent', evaluated at render time, same as the camilleTrust_high/_not_high pattern used elsewhere.

cards.text: Full validation protocol ahead of commissioning
Backup power and UPS system for the cleanroom
Secondary supplier qualification for critical components
Executive viewing gallery overlooking the production floor

TOOL_ACT2_SCENE02_MOSCOW.effectApplication: On placement (or scene completion, engine's choice), deduct the card's costByBucket[chosenBucket] from budgetRemaining. Re-placing a card into a different bucket should refund the old cost and apply the new one — not stack both.

overcommitRule.condition: 6 or more of the 8 cards placed in Must
overcommitRule.note: EV-E3 already exists in events.json — fires as Marcus's dry reaction line ('You've just doubled the budget.'), authored as the first line of DIALOGUE_ACT2_SCENE02_POST, conditioned on this reactionFlag. Engine re-checks bucket/minCount live after every placement (not sticky), so moving cards back out of Must below the threshold clears the flag again before the player finishes.

TOOL_ACT2_SCENE02_MOSCOW.completionCondition: All 8 cards placed in some bucket (Won't counts as placed)
